description: Phase 2 eMTB Study Data is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Bicycles and Pedestrians", published or maintained by U.S. DOT Volpe Center. Data collected for a Volpe/FHWA study at three locations. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Bicycles and Pedestrians". It has 18 columns, among them category_group, long, speed_mph, participant, experience_on_trail, E-Bike.Class. The portal shows 2025-07-31 as the last data update. Attribution given: U.S. DOT Volpe Center. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
